Corollary
[Gradient and time-derivative bounds for Type I reduced distance] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0169, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0170 ↗ lem:chow-iv-type-i-reduced-distance-quadratic-upper-growth 1. ch30:30.16\group Singular-Time Reduced Volume

Under the hypotheses of Lemma 2, there are $C,D,E,F<\infty $, depending only on $n,\varepsilon ,M$, such that \[ |\nabla \ell |(x,t)\leq \frac C{\sqrt{\omega -t}} +\frac{D d_{g(t)}(p,x)}{\omega -t}, \qquad |\partial _t\ell |(x,t)\leq \frac E{\omega -t} +\frac{F d_{g(t)}(p,x)^2}{(\omega -t)^2}. \]
